World map with temporal "travel" integrated into the app itself.

- **🌍 In-app world map** (Results tab): motif view with per-culture proverb tooltips
  and attestation arcs; shared-wisdom network (120 strongest culture pairs); Europe zoom.
- **Time slider** — "attested by year N" — driven by the corpus's *attested-no-later-than*
  bounds (5,738 dated proverbs, earliest 1611); undated attestations shown faded.
  Watch a motif's documented record accumulate across centuries.
- Self-contained HTML (no external requests), generated live from the database.
- New data assets: compact public-domain world outline, 67 extendable cultural centroids.

Full history: `CHANGELOG.md`. Run: `pip install -r requirements.txt && streamlit run app.py`
